description: Fork of exp329 (tiny LUT-LM, 21.8 M, val_bpb @ 8K = 1.7555) bumping residual_tph 8 -> 64 (8x more residual_lut tables). Per the residual-lut wide-beats-deep finding, residual_tph is the dominant capacity lever. Per-layer residual_lut params: 8*64*384 = 196K -> 64*64*384 = 1.57M (8x); 6 layers 1.18M -> 9.43M. Total model ~21.8 M -> ~30.0 M. All other LUTs unchanged (qkv_tph=8, v_tph=8, out_tph_per_layer=[32,32,16,16,16,16]). Tests how far residual_lut capacity alone narrows the +0.37 bpb gap to vanilla bs=16 (exp328 = 1.3882).
